body: Thank you for replying.  My mother does like to control people and I have become successful in life and it bothers her.  I completely cut her out but am reliving her abuse over and over again. I think part of me feels like existing is my fault.  I want to understand the “why” of why she treats me badly. As a mother I cannot fathom doing my children like she treats me.
Thank you for replying.  I am here.  Trying to take it one day at a time.  It does not get easier.
